prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, close on a small attic window from outside, snow on the sill and frost ferns across the glass: through the frost, a tiny white woman in her eighties with thin silver hair in a hairnet, a long pointed nose and a mole on one cheek, in three cardigans and a crocheted blanket, frost on the glass, a short candle stub burnt low beside her presses her ear to an identical 1930s wooden cathedral-top radio with a glowing amber dial, eyes half closed, breath steaming, her real-skinned face lit amber from the dial on one side and by the candle stub on the other. The small red moon hangs in a clear pane of the glass. Snow on the slates around the window. Most of the frame cold blue; the brightest values are the amber dial and the candle flame. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
